text: రోగికి జ్వరం 3 రోజుల నుండి ఉంది, temperature 101 F ఉంది.
BP 140/90 undi, pulse 88 undi, patient ki paracetamol 500 mg TDS ivvandi.
మధుమేహం ఉంది, HbA1c 8.2 vachindi, metformin 500 mg BD start cheyandi.
SpO2 96 percent undi, amoxicillin 500 mg TDS 5 rojula paatu ivvandi.
gunde nokka undi, BP 150/95, amlodipine 5 mg OD start cheyandi.
kadupu noppi 2 rojula nundi undi, pantoprazole 40 mg OD ivvandi.
cholesterol ekkuva undi, atorvastatin 10 mg OD raatra pettandi, follow up 2 weeks lo.
type 2 diabetes patient ki insulin 10 units రాత్రి ivvandi, blood sugar fasting 180 undi.
मरीज़ को 3 दिन से बुखार है, temperature 101 F है, BP 140/90 है.
pulse 88 hai, paracetamol 500 mg TDS 2 din ke liye दें.
मधुमेह है, HbA1c 8.2 आया है, metformin 500 mg BD शुरू करें.
SpO2 96 percent hai, amoxicillin 500 mg TDS 5 din ke liye दें.
सीने में दर्द है, BP 150/95 है, amlodipine 5 mg OD शुरू करें.
pet mein dard 2 din se hai, pantoprazole 40 mg OD दें.
कोलेस्ट्रॉल ज़्यादा है, atorvastatin 10 mg OD रात को दें, 2 हफ़्ते में follow up.
type 2 diabetes है, insulin 10 units रात को दें, fasting sugar 180 है.
Patient ko fever hai 3 din se, temperature 101 F, BP check karo 140/90.
Pulse 88 hai, paracetamol 500 mg TDS de do, 2 dino ke liye.
Diabetes ka case hai, HbA1c 8.2 aaya hai, metformin 500 mg BD start karo.
SpO2 96 percent hai, amoxicillin 500 mg TDS 5 din ke liye de do.
Chest pain hai, BP 150/95 hai, amlodipine 5 mg OD start karo.
Abdomen mein pain hai 2 din se, pantoprazole 40 mg OD de do.
Cholesterol high hai, atorvastatin 10 mg OD raat ko de do, 2 weeks mein follow up.
Type 2 diabetes hai, insulin 10 units raat ko de do, fasting sugar 180 hai.
